Title: [LSJ] Descent into Darkness with Daring the Dawn

Messages.Author: Jyhad_addict
Messages.Body:
If i dare the Dawn to descent into darkness (i know that
it sounds ricculus), what happens ?
When i burn the descent to move the vampire to play,
is he in torpor or not ?
Daring the Dawn specifies, that the acting vampire takes
the aggravated damage, after the action is completed. After
the descent into darkness action completes, the vampire is out
of play and it is not possible to take any amount of damage.
My guess is that i can play daring the dawn to descent
and still not take any negative effects, thus when returning
to play my minion is not in torpor. But then again, what
matters is not what i guess, but what lsj rules.
So, What do you say allmighty guru of vtes ?
